newsitem.title: NETHERLANDS: ING starts pension fund with Mexican Bital.
newsitem.headline: ING starts pension fund with Mexican Bital.

text.p: Financial services group ING Groep NV (ING) said on Wednesday it had signed a joint venture agreement with Mexican retail bank Bital to manage a pension fund company.
ING owns 49 percent of the newly established Afore Bital joint venture, Bital owns the remaining 51 percent.
Afore Bital starts selling its products as of today through Bital's 1,000 branches and also plans to sell through the tied agents network of ING Insurance Mexico in the future.
ING said Bital had 2.8 million customers and was Mexico's fifth largest retail bank.
Total investment between the partners was 66 million guilders, ING said in a statement.
"We see excellent opportunities for the privatised pension fund market in Mexico," ING said in its statement.
Since February 3, individuals in Mexico have been able to transfer their pension balances from government-run accounts to private pension administrators called Afores.
